summary_ja: 信用リスク削減手法の契約文書が全当事者を拘束し全ての関連法令に照らして有効であること、及びその継続的な検証を求める。
summary_en: Credit risk mitigation documentation must bind all parties and be legally effective in all relevant jurisdictions, verified on an ongoing basis.
paragraphs: Where credit risk mitigation techniques are applied in calculating risk-weighted assets, the documents relating to the contract for those credit risk mitigation techniques shall bind all parties involved in the transaction and shall be effective in light of all laws relevant to that transaction.
An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach shall verify on an ongoing basis the legal effectiveness provided in the preceding paragraph.
